leadText: (Korean: 포켓몬 영어 마스터 Pokémon English Master) is a Pokémon manhwa published in South Korea by Pokémon Korea, Inc. in 2015. It was written and illustrated by 배연오 and supervised by 박약우 (Volume 1) and 김태은 (Volume 2). It was developed to help children to learn English.
plainText:
(Korean: 포켓몬 영어 마스터 Pokémon English Master) is a Pokémon manhwa published in South Korea by Pokémon Korea, Inc. in 2015. It was written and illustrated by 배연오 and supervised by 박약우 (Volume 1) and 김태은 (Volume 2). It was developed to help children to learn English.
